test_run_messages_returns_envelope: test the GET /api/runs/{run_id}/messages endpoint returns data and has_more fields
test_run_messages_404_when_run_not_found: test the messages endpoint returns 404 when the run is not found in the store
test_run_messages_has_more_true_when_ext: test the messages endpoint sets has_more to true when more than 50 messages exist
test_run_messages_passes_after_seq_to_ev: test the after_seq query param is forwarded to the event store for pagination
test_run_messages_respects_custom_limit: test the messages endpoint respects a custom limit parameter capped at 200
